units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 2:3">Pes. II, 3</cite> <he>כל … לחַפֵּשׂ אחריו</he> what the dog cannot reach by digging for it.
<cite ref="Shabbat 89a:3">Sabb. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>חִיפַּשְׂתִּי וכ׳</he> I searched all over the world.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:9">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>אם אתה מחַפֵּשׂ אחר וכ׳</he> if thou wilt dig after the words of the Law as for secret treasures; a. fr.
